title: ui skill router: the Actions row's In column says src/actions/*.actions.ts, but action files are NAME.action.ts
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbUb7TcZK1XUAddUmQ

Filing gate: follow-up from the contract review of PR #35279 (comment 6997263802, pre-existing, escalated by the reviewer), filed by seat 5. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:85` (router table, Actions row) names the files as `src/actions/*.actions.ts`. The metadata registry's action patterns are `**/*.action.ts` and `**/*.action.yml` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts:969`), the generator writes `NAME.action.ts` (reviewer's reading), and the showcase keeps them at `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/*.action.ts`. An agent following the router looks for, or creates, files with the wrong suffix.

## Do

Read the generator and loader first and cite them; then correct the In column (and any other `*.actions.ts` mention under `skills/` and `ui/skills/`) to the suffix the platform loads. Check whether `*.actions.ts` is also accepted anywhere (barrel or `defineStack` import); if so say both. Same-file restatement cut to pay the ratchet, as #35279 did.

## Done when

The router names the files the platform loads, with the code cited in the PR; skill gates pass; contract review (governed `skills/**`).
